lede: Denver took Sunday night on a Bo Nix dive with 47 seconds left, and Zach finishes another week on nothing. Mark has first place whatever happens tonight — the only question is how much daylight he gets.

beats.text: Talanoa Hufanga returned a pick 66 yards for Denver's first lead, Bo Nix dived in late, and Hufanga picked Stafford again to end it. That's Anthony to 6 — and his Eagles play tonight, so he's the only owner who can still add to this week.

Favored on the road at altitude and beaten by four. That's two scoreless weeks out of three, and his teams are a combined 2-10. The Chargers and Dolphins are both 0-3. Nothing about the market's opinion of his roster has matched what it does on Sundays.

beats.tag: Tonight · how big the gap gets
beats.text: Philadelphia at Chicago closes the week, and Mark finishes on top either way — Jon is done on 8 and nobody else can reach 9. What's actually on it is the margin. Chicago wins with Tyson Bagent and Mark goes to 10: two clear of Jon, four clear of the pack, his biggest lead yet. Philadelphia wins and Mark stays on 9 while Anthony climbs to 7 — which tightens the chase behind him rather than the lead itself.

Baker Mayfield dislocated the thumb on his throwing hand in Tampa's loss to Minnesota. The Buccaneers are 0-3, the Cowboys have lost two one-score games, and Bill sits on 5 with the least convincing roster in the top half.
